# Zscaler ZIA Web and DNS Activity

Web proxy and DNS activity for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), normalized through ASIM. Web panels query `_Im_WebSession`; DNS panels query `_Im_Dns`. All queries filter on `EventVendor == 'Zscaler'` and use only standard ASIM fields.

parameters.name: Workspaces
parameters.label: Workspace
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| project id, name

content.query:
let base = _Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler';
union isfuzzy=true
    (base | summarize Count=count() | extend Metric='Total Requests'),
    (base | where EventResult == 'Failure' | summarize Count=count() | extend Metric='Blocked Requests'),
    (base | summarize Count=dcount(SrcUsername) | extend Metric='Unique Users'),
    (base | summarize Count=dcount(Url) | extend Metric='Unique Domains'),
    (base | summarize Count=sum(NetworkBytes) | extend Metric='Total Bytes')
| project Metric, Count

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| summarize EventCount=count() by EventResult, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(Url)
| summarize RequestCount=count(), BlockedCount=countif(EventResult == 'Failure') by Url
| top 10 by RequestCount desc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventResult == 'Failure'
| where isnotempty(ThreatCategory)
| summarize BlockedCount=count() by ThreatCategory
| top 10 by BlockedCount desc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(SrcUsername)
| summarize RequestCount=count(), BlockedCount=countif(EventResult == 'Failure') by SrcUsername
| top 10 by RequestCount desc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(SrcIpAddr)
| summarize RequestCount=count() by SrcIpAddr
| top 10 by RequestCount desc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| extend HttpStatusCode=coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('HttpStatusCode','')),tostring(column_ifexists('HttpStatusCode_string','')),tostring(column_ifexists('HttpStatusCode_int',int(null))),tostring(AdditionalFields['HttpStatusCode']))
| where isnotempty(HttpStatusCode)
| summarize RequestCount=count() by HttpStatusCode
| top 10 by RequestCount desc

_Im_WebSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(HttpUserAgent)
| summarize RequestCount=count() by HttpUserAgent
| top 10 by RequestCount desc

let base = _Im_Dns
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler';
union isfuzzy=true
    (base | summarize Count=count() | extend Metric='Total DNS Queries'),
    (base | where EventResult == 'Failure' | summarize Count=count() | extend Metric='Failed Queries'),
    (base | summarize Count=dcount(DnsQuery) | extend Metric='Unique Domains Queried'),
    (base | summarize Count=dcount(SrcIpAddr) | extend Metric='Unique Clients')
| project Metric, Count

_Im_Dns
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| summarize EventCount=count() by EventResult, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

_Im_Dns
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(DnsQuery)
| summarize QueryCount=count() by DnsQuery
| top 10 by QueryCount desc

_Im_Dns
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(DnsQueryType)
| summarize QueryCount=count() by DnsQueryTypeName
| top 10 by QueryCount desc

_Im_Dns
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventResult == 'Failure'
| where isnotempty(SrcIpAddr)
| summarize FailedCount=count() by SrcIpAddr
| top 10 by FailedCount desc
